title: Bloom Energy is Hot Right Now, But Does it Deserve the Hype?!
description: My Full List From Avoids to Market Leaders
body_html:
Happy hump day in the stock market! If you are new to my page, my name is Timothy, an investor since 2007. I studied Economics at the U.S. Naval Academy and worked in the defense industry, at the Pentagon, General Dynamics and Huntington Ingalls. Though I had been gradually investing my entire career, I got so sick of the corporate world in 2018 that I withdrew all of my retirement accounts, and dumped them into stocks and crypto. In 2021 my life pretty much changed as those investments came to fruition. As I was selling off those assets, I made a few videos about selling on TikTok… angering many people lol… which caused virality. I have over 576,000 followers on the platform (currently I am deactivated, taking a break from video content.)

My style of investing is 80% technical, 20% fundamental and I am known as a “mid-term” investor (several weeks or months). I do not believe in HODL or “diamond hands”… or in holding losing assets for years. I play the same winning strategy, over and over again. Nothing special about it, just discipline and repetition.

The market continues to push higher; yesterday much of the short term drop has already been consumed. As much as I love ❤️a bearish call…there is absolutely no reason to be a bear. Currently 8 out of 11 of our positions are deep in the green, with WSFS leading the charge up 19.27% in just 4 months, 2 of those during the market draw down…I have been chanting since January, that Finance is the overlooked sector by most retail investors.

This is Mid-Week Movers, where I review your favorite stocks, from worst to first 🥇. The image below shows some of the more popular stocks that were selected for review. Bloom Energy was the top stock the StockTok Screener selected last year, providing over 230% in profit. Personally, I caught a fraction of that trend…regardless, this stock has hit headlines and attention again…Jim Cramer from Mad Money loves .1 We will take a look and see if he is right or not…. 😶

The Full List of Stocks Being Reviewed:

  • Aeva Technologies - AEVA - Electronic Technology

  • Amprius Technologies - AMPX - Producer Manufacturing

  • ASE Technology - ASX - Semiconductors

  • Bloom Energy - BE - Electronic Production Equipment

  • FuelCell Energy - FCEL - Electronic Equipment

  • Comfort Systems USA - FIX - Engineering & Construction

  • Legence Corp. - LGN - Engineering & Construction

  • Novo Nordisk - NOV - Pharmaceuticals

  • Plug Power - PLUG - Electronic Production Equipment

  • Sea Limited - SE - Internet Retail

  • Sandisk Corp. - SNDK - Computer Peripherals

  • Target - TGT - Specialty Stores

  • Tetra Tech - TTK - Engineering & Construction

  • USA Rare Earth - USAR - Metal Fabrication

  • Vicor Corp. - VICR - Electronic Components

  • Western Digital Corp. - WDC - Computer Peripherals

  • Clear Secure - YOU - Packaged Software

Lets eliminate the loser stocks first…

How do you hit an all time high? Or even a local high? Answer is simple: price MUST be above the 200 day moving average (it has to be above several moving averages, but this is a standardized approach).

Novo Nordisk, Sea Limited (a stock we profited from last year) and Tetra Tech ALL have price action below the 200 day moving average. Maybe it goes up from here. Maybe you are getting the BEST price. But I do not try to time bottoms, a futile effort. Those trends are down right now, and thus, they are immediately eliminated. I apologize if this hurts some of your feelings, but the market does not care about feelings…its the harsh truth.

These Stocks are TOO GOOD…so they are eliminated…

Remember I mentioned above, that I do the same thing, over and over again. It gets kind of boring honestly. I play Volatility Contraction Patterns (VCPs) and croissants…both with incredibly high hit rates. VCP’s are used by Mark Minervini, 2-time U.S. Investing Champion. If Mark had been born ~35 years earlier, he would blow investors like Warren Buffett out of the water (I do not know why he is so idolized 🙄). VCPs and croissants do not guarantee a win, but odds are significantly in your favor.

VCP’s and croissants offer what is known as SEPA, specific entry point analysis. This is an optimal entry point, near the break out of the consolidation pattern. The goal here is to get into a winning position, and guess where the top is when profits are already locked (using a stop). When I look at a chart, and it is pointing strait up for days/weeks/months, we lose that SEPA. I have no idea where the top is at, nor does anyone. But I do know that a significant portion of the upward runway has been taken away. The image below provides you a visualization of what I am referencing here.

Let me abundantly clear, if I was to take a position in any of these: I WOULD GO LONG. Trend is friend, trend is up. Go with it. But because I cannot make a good SEPA entry, in an attempt to get into a winning position first, these stocks have simply ran too much, on the monthly, per my strategy.

ASE Technology, Comfort Systems, Western Digital, Sandisk and Legence Corp are all eliminated. If you currently hold any of these, there is absolutely no reason to sell. Put your stop into a profit you are happy with, and ride the trend as long as possible.

Quickly Eliminating Target As Well

In 2024 I posted that Target looked terrible. Since then, it dropped -51% to trough, -30% to current price. The entire retail sector has been falling like dominoes, from small caps (like Dollar General) and working its way to large caps (like Costco). Costco and Walmart remain on my FUTURE short list (they are not ready yet) as they will be the last dominoes to fall. Yes I know, they are great businesses…well aware.

Target’s long term trend remains downward, with only lower lows and lower highs. Yes, it has short term spikes, but trend is not friend. This is a hard “avoid” from me. Similar to the stocks above, in that if you are currently holding (bought early 2026) and in profit… put a stop in profit and squeeze as much profit out as possible. Maybe you will get lucky and trend resumes upward, but its not a good “buy” for today.

Subscribe now

Clear Secure, YOU, is unique…

If you are a mid-term investor (few days or weeks) - AVOID

If you are a long-term investor (few weeks or months) - BUY

On Monday, I wrote: “When to sell” and one of the reliable indications is when we get bearish divergences, particularly several divergences. On the daily chart, YOU is presenting a strong quadruple divergence. My speculation is that this stock will “cool off” here soon for a few days, possibly weeks. HOWEVER, on the Monthly timeframe, Clear Secure is presenting a nice croissant breakout, 1 of the 2 patterns I often trade. Its not the BEST SEPA entry, but it also has not went parabolic. So if you are a longer term investor, I think you can get a slightly better price in a few days, before the macro trend upwards resumes.

Now, we have 7 really bullish looking stock charts remaining…is Cramer oddly right?!

Stocks remaining: AEVA, AMPX, BE, PLUG, USAR, VICR and FCEL…

Though I am much more of a “charts” investor, I realize some prefer fundamentals, and to a degree, I agree. It would be negligent if we did not cover that. In general I care about 2 things fundamentally:

  1. Is the company profitable, or becoming profitable (measured with cashflow)

  2. Are shareholders making more money, or trending better (measured with EPS)

To be clear, none of these remaining 8 companies pass all of the checks. As you can see, it is a mixture of results.

What I do want to absolutely avoid though, is atrocious fundamentals. Though fundamentally terrible companies can have momentous stock runs, often times, they are short lived, hard to time and do not offer us a situation to get into a profitable position before guessing where the top is at.

Please do not forget to LIKE ❤️ and re-stack 🔄 to combat the AI slop!

Because of this, Amprius Technologies, AMPX; USA Rare Earth, USAR and Vicor Corporation, VICR are all eliminated. Of these 3, VICR has the best looking daily and monthly charts. And to be clear, like I mentioned, companies with bad fundamentals can go up in stock price. But as a public finance content creator, I cannot recommend these (even though nothing I say is ever financial advice. Contact your local Financial Advisor, in which ~92% of them under perform the S&P 5002 😂).

So between Plug Power, Bloom Energy, Aeva Technologies and FuelCell Energy… which is the BEST buy?

I will break these 4 down for short term investors (few days), mid term investors (few weeks) and long term investors (few months), as each will have a different answer…
